subject: how to convert the 2D histogram counts into density/probability

messages.author: 9e9ea8c0d73c4cac
messages.subject: how to convert the 2D histogram counts into density/probability
parts:
Dear ggplot2 users,

Recently, I am trying to use the ggplot and stat_bin2d command to draw a 2D histogram. However, I found that the stat_bin2d just gave us the counts within each cell. Is there anybody who can tell me how to convert the counts into density/probability profiles? Below are the command I used:

p <- ggplot(data, aes(x, y))

h3 <- p + stat_bin2d()

h3

Anticipating for your reply!

Xujun
